description: Two unsafe iam:PassRole grants, neither of which any bundled cfn-guard rule reaches. ArtifactPublisherPolicy is a standalone AWS::IAM::Policy allowing iam:PassRole on the wildcarded role ARN arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy/*, so every role under that path can be passed; this is the wildcarded-ARN shape of passrole_unrestricted, where case-001 covers the bare Resource "*" shape in an inline role policy. InstanceLauncherRole holds ec2:RunInstances and a named, iam:PassedToService-scoped iam:PassRole in one document: each statement is defensible alone, and together they let the holder read the passed role's credentials from instance metadata, which is dangerous_ec2_passrole. rules/iam/iam_policy_no_star_star.guard covers AWS::IAM::Policy but only matches Action "*" with Resource "*", so it is silent on both resources -- the reason both expectations are attributed to IAM Review alone. The role's trust policy is deliberately correct, a service principal bounded by aws:SourceAccount, so that privesc_broad_trust and cross_service_missing_condition do not add a second IAM defect that would merge into the same finding. The template declares no S3 bucket, no RDS instance and no taggable resource type, so no other bundled rule applies.

expected_findings.note: iam:PassRole on the wildcarded role ARN arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy/*. Reported by passrole_unrestricted, which recognises a wildcarded role ARN as leaving the grant unbounded, and additionally by wildcard_resource and sensitive_prefix_without_condition on the same statement; all three are IAM findings on this resource, so they merge into this one entry and CRITICAL comes from passrole_unrestricted.

ec2:RunInstances and iam:PassRole allowed in the same inline policy document, reported by dangerous_ec2_passrole. The PassRole grant names a single role and carries an iam:PassedToService condition, so passrole_unrestricted and sensitive_prefix_without_condition do not fire on it; wildcard_resource does fire on the wildcarded instance ARN of the RunInstances statement, and merges into this entry at the same HIGH severity.
